newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Helvetia sees higher 1997 profit, dividend.
newsitem.headline: Helvetia sees higher 1997 profit, dividend.

text.p: Swiss insurer Helvetia Partia Holding said it expected to boost group profit and dividend in 1997, with double-digit earnings growth seen this year.

"Our long-term goal is to have double-digit percentage growth in net profit and we think we will achieve that this year," chief executive Erich Walser told Reuters after a news conference. "We expect that the profit growth planned will also be reflected in the dividend," he added without elaborating.
He said premium volume should grow five percent in 1997 from 3.74 billion last year and costs should fall 0.5 percent.
